title: ThemeProvider missing surface/border/text/page CSS variables
description:
The ThemeProvider's injectStyle() only defines 6 CSS variables:

  --azimuth-accent
  --azimuth-color-primary
  --azimuth-color-primary-hover
  --azimuth-color-accent-hover
  --azimuth-color-primary-subtle
  --azimuth-color-accent-subtle

But components require these additional variables which are NEVER defined:

  --azimuth-color-surface        (used by Card, Input, Button, option buttons)
  --azimuth-color-surface-hover  (used by option button hover)
  --azimuth-color-border         (used by Card, Input, option buttons)
  --azimuth-color-border-strong  (used by hover/focus states)
  --azimuth-color-text           (used everywhere)
  --azimuth-color-text-secondary (used by descriptions/secondary text)
  --azimuth-color-text-muted     (used by helper text)
  --azimuth-color-on-primary     (used by primary button text)
  --azimuth-color-page           (used by body/page background)
  --azimuth-color-error-bg       (used by Alert/error styling)
  --azimuth-color-error-text     (used by Alert/error styling)

Because these variables have no value, components using them have invisible or low-contrast UIs in both light AND dark mode (white on white, dark on dark).

Fix: Add these variable definitions to both the light and dark injectStyle blocks in ThemeProvider. Suggested values:

Light mode (against oklch(98.5% 0.005 85) page background):
  --azimuth-color-page: oklch(98.5% 0.005 85)
  --azimuth-color-surface: oklch(100% 0 0)
  --azimuth-color-surface-hover: oklch(97% 0.003 85)
  --azimuth-color-border: oklch(87% 0.006 85)
  --azimuth-color-border-strong: oklch(65% 0.01 85)
  --azimuth-color-text: oklch(20% 0.01 85)
  --azimuth-color-text-secondary: oklch(45% 0.008 85)
  --azimuth-color-text-muted: oklch(60% 0.006 85)
  --azimuth-color-on-primary: oklch(100% 0 0)
  --azimuth-color-error-bg: oklch(93% 0.04 25)
  --azimuth-color-error-text: oklch(45% 0.15 25)

Dark mode (against oklch(14% 0.008 220)):
  --azimuth-color-page: oklch(14% 0.008 220)
  --azimuth-color-surface: oklch(19% 0.01 220)
  --azimuth-color-surface-hover: oklch(23% 0.012 220)
  --azimuth-color-border: oklch(28% 0.015 220)
  --azimuth-color-border-strong: oklch(40% 0.02 220)
  --azimuth-color-text: oklch(90% 0.005 85)
  --azimuth-color-text-secondary: oklch(70% 0.008 85)
  --azimuth-color-text-muted: oklch(55% 0.006 85)
  --azimuth-color-on-primary: oklch(100% 0 0)
  --azimuth-color-error-bg: oklch(20% 0.06 25)
  --azimuth-color-error-text: oklch(75% 0.12 25)

title: Clean up or integrate 860 untracked SVG icons in src/icons/
description:
## Issue
`src/icons/` contains 860 raw SVG files (587 brand + 273 regular icons) with no TypeScript integration — no `index.ts`, no barrel export, no use by the Icon primitive. They are untracked by git and excluded from the build. This is dead weight that adds confusion.

## Options
1. **Remove** the icons directory entirely — cleanest if not needed.
2. **Integrate** them into the Icon primitive with proper type exports and tree-shaking.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Decide on remove vs integrate approach
- [ ] Execute the chosen approach
- [ ] `src/icons/` is no longer listed in `git status` as untracked

title: Dark mode contrast — Input, ProgressBar, and general surface visibility
description:
When ThemeProvider mode is set to 'system' and the OS is in dark mode, several components have poor contrast:

1. **Input** — text input has a border/background that blends into the dark surface, making the input field nearly invisible
2. **ProgressBar** — the track/background fills are dark-on-dark in dark mode
3. **Placeholder text** — placeholder color is too similar to the input text color in dark mode

The ThemeProvider correctly sets data-theme='dark' on <html> and injects dark CSS variables, but the default dark values may not provide sufficient contrast ratios for these components.

Steps to reproduce:
1. Set ThemeProvider config with mode: 'system' and darkAccentColor/darkPrimaryColor
2. Open the page on a system with prefers-color-scheme: dark
3. Observe Input component — border and background are nearly identical
4. Observe ProgressBar — track invisible against page background

Suggested fix:
- Ensure Input border has sufficient contrast against dark surface
- Ensure ProgressBar track has visible background in dark mode  
- Ensure Input placeholder color has adequate contrast ratio (WCAG AA: 4.5:1)
- Test with oklch color values in dark mode

title: Add per-component sub-path exports in package.json
description:
## Issue
`package.json` only maps the root barrel (`.`) and `./styles.css`. There are no per-component sub-path exports like `./Button`. While tree-shaking works from the barrel, explicit sub-path exports improve bundler resolution and enable deeper tree-shaking for consumers.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Each component/primitives/layout folder has a sub-path export entry
- [ ] Dual format (import/require) preserved for each sub-path
- [ ] Type declarations included for each entry
- [ ] Build still passes (`npm run build`)

title: Add InfoButton component (i icon with popover)
description:
There's no component for an info/popover button — the 'i' icon that opens a small card with additional context. This is needed for the project-bootstrapper wizard's market region selector to explain which countries are included in each region.

Requirements:
- Small circular 'i' icon button
- On click/hover opens a popover/card with rich text content
- Dismisses on click outside or Escape
- WCAG 2.2 AA: aria-expanded, aria-controls, keyboard dismissible
- Compact — should not shift layout
- Should work inside forms and tight spaces

Current alternatives: Tooltip (too limited for multi-line content), Dialog (too heavy).
